title: Serializable transfers + internal service auth
summary: Fixes a race condition in transfer logic by wrapping the operation in a SERIALIZABLE transaction with automatic retry on serialization failure.
Adds internal service authentication via `X-Internal-Service` header to support the payouts worker, bypassing JWT verification.
Includes a webhook notification call to emit transfer events to partners (side effect not mentioned in PR body).

review_targets.why: New internal service auth bypass introduced. Check: is INTERNAL_SERVICES defined and validated securely? Is the header check placed before the JWT fallback intentionally? Risk: auth bypass if misconfigured.

Core serializable transaction logic with retry. Check: does the SELECT FOR UPDATE ordering prevent deadlocks? Is the retry loop capped and safe? Is notifyTransfer() idempotent or deduped? Risk: data loss, duplicate webhooks, infinite retries.

Transaction retry wrapper—critical for the concurrency fix. Check: does it handle all serialization error codes? Is there exponential backoff or a retry budget? Does it preserve transaction semantics? Risk: data corruption if retry logic is flawed.
